The Biden administration is threatening—and has sued—local
governments and law enforcement agencies across the country that have
implemented measures to curb an epidemic of crime, drugs and gang
violence in rental properties asserting that the policies “unfairly
penalize communities of color.” The popular laws, enacted by
thousands of cities nationwide are commonly known as “crime-free”
and “nuisance” programs that restrict housing based on criminal
and arrest records and punish landlords and tenants with excessive
calls to police and emergency services or those engaged in criminal
activity. To improve living conditions in mainly low-income rentals
2,000 cities across 48 states have adopted crime-free and nuisance
policies, according to the Department of Justice (DOJ), which has
legally challenged many of the measures in the last few years claiming
that they are discriminatory and therefore violate federal law.

Dear Peter,
As six in ten Americans suffer from chronic diseases, largely due to the toxic chemicals in our food supply, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has made it his lifelong mission to expose and address the root causes of our nation’s health crisis.
From his ongoing presidential campaign to his decades-long advocacy, Kennedy has championed regenerative agriculture and challenged the corrupt alliance between Big Pharma, government agencies, and the food industry that keeps Americans sick.
[This fight for healthier, more sustainable food systems is echoed in the eye-opening Tucker Carlson podcast](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6EQ6sUlCj-zytkS_cwzfZz2bulG0TsyEHHQtEh8lEDQpDwrBD8cssVudPnC1c9gZy5gvBtWFd6aCH_L5KI6NTLEl2nGP3dzM0jjydK48rCuYriRoD95bgY2YVFXSOILQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tucker_carlson_8_21_all_1&n=3), where whistleblowers Casey and Calley Means delve into how Big Pharma has co-opted our health systems, ensuring that toxins like glyphosate and seed oils continue to poison our food supply.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6EQ6sUlCj-zytkS_cwzfZz2bulG0TsyEHHQtEh8lEDQpDwrBD8cssVudPnC1c9gZy5gvBtWFd6aCH_L5KI6NTLEl2nGP3dzM0jjydK48rCuYriRoD95bgY2YVFXSOILQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tucker_carlson_8_21_all_1&n=4)
Casey, a Stanford-educated physician and co-founder of Levels, left a successful medical career to combat the real reasons behind America’s metabolic health crisis. Her brother, Calley, co-founder of Truemed, joins her in exposing how these industries have manipulated public health for profit.
Together, they discuss a range of critical issues, from the lies behind the food pyramid and the dangers of seed oils to the rise of dementia, infertility, and the harmful effects of vaccines and birth control.
Kennedy’s commitment to revitalizing America’s health isn’t just about better farming practices—it’s about dismantling the corporate grip on our food and health industries.
[Tune in](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6EQ6sUlCj-zytkS_cwzfZz2bulG0TsyEHHQtEh8lEDQpDwrBD8cssVudPnC1c9gZy5gvBtWFd6aCH_L5KI6NTLEl2nGP3dzM0jjydK48rCuYriRoD95bgY2YVFXSOILQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tucker_carlson_8_21_all_1&n=5) to hear how his vision aligns with the Means’ revelations and why Kennedy is the only candidate to truly rebuild America from the ground up.
[This isn’t just a podcast—it’s a call to action for every American concerned about their health and the future of our nation.](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=6EQ6sUlCj-zytkS_cwzfZz2bulG0TsyEHHQtEh8lEDQpDwrBD8cssVudPnC1c9gZy5gvBtWFd6aCH_L5KI6NTLEl2nGP3dzM0jjydK48rCuYriRoD95bgY2YVFXSOILQ&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tucker_carlson_8_21_all_1&n=6)

Saying you are Retired means something.
#
Peter,
There is nothing Republicans like to do more than attack veterans. Twenty-years ago during the Democratic Convention, they did it with the Purple Heart band-aids, mocking John Kerry's service in Vietnam.
Today, the Trump campaign shared a letter attacking Tim Walz service that was signed by 50 Republican members of Congress.
It was a textbook example of Stolen Valor.
**A full 29 of the 50 signatures come from Republicans who falsely claimed they are retired.**
Calling yourself Retired means something. It speaks to a length of time in service that many of the people on that list of Republicans never fulfilled.
But truly, the most egregious example is Ronny Jackson who claimed to be a retired flag officer despite being demoted from Rear Admiral to Captain.
Troy Nehls was on the list as well, which would be funny to anyone who has seen him wear a Combat Infantryman’s Badge that he never earned!
Like we said, it was a textbook example of Stolen Valor as they attempt to Swift Boat Tim Walz.

body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis — last night
at the DNC, Bernie was met with standing ovations as he laid out the path
for Democrats to deliver for all of us and take on the billionaire class.

Bernie said: “These oligarchs tell us we shouldn't tax the rich; take on
price gouging; expand Medicare to cover dental, hearing, and vision; and
increase social security benefits — well, I've got some bad news for them
— that is precisely what we are going to do!”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1011&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ]Bernie and our movement put these popular policies on the agenda, but
he called for more on the DNC stage. Add your voice to stand with Bernie!
This is how we win in November and win for the American people.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1012&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ][IMG]

The undaunted Senator from Vermont took direct aim at “Big Pharma, Big
Oil, Big Ag, Big Tech and all the corporate monopolists whose greed is
denying progress for working people,” and the crowd at the DNC broke into
chants of “Bernie, Bernie!”

In the people’s fight against corporate power, oligarchs, and
billionaires, Bernie said, “We are going to win this struggle.” But we
know it will take all of us standing together to get it done.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1013&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ]Stand with Bernie: Pledge to fight alongside Bernie and Our Revolution
to win the progressives policies that work for all people, not just the
billionaire class.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1014&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ]ADD YOUR NAME

It wasn’t only a message of economic populism last night. Bernie also
called for an end to the horrific war in Gaza and an immediate Ceasefire.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1015&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ][IMG]

His calls for an end to Israel’s bombing of innocent Palestinians received
a loud round of applause — because the American people widely support an
end to the U.S. government funding the atrocities against Gazans.

What Bernie has done since running for president in 2016 is nothing short
of transformative, but we know the struggle continues. He used the
spotlight at the DNC to put forth a winning vision for 2024 and beyond:
Health care as a right NOT a privilege, raising the minimum wage to a
LIVING wage, overturning Citizens United to get big money out of politics,
and much more.

“When the political will is there, government can effectively deliver for
the people of our country,” Bernie said. Let us stand now to make our
political will known in this pivotal moment.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19266?source=email-20240821&t=1016&akid=6629%2E5885482%2EZcpFBh ]Raise your voice with Bernie: Sign your name to call for this
transformative agenda to uplift all Americans and push for an end to
America’s support for Israel’s war on Gaza.

When we organize, we win.

name: MassDems
subject: Happy Wednesday from the DNC! Day Three RECAP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hello Democrats! We're excited to share our daily update from Chicago.
Last night, several Republicans came before a Democratic convention to tell how the extremism of today’s MAGA Republican Party has driven them to support Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Second Gentleman Doug Emhoff showed what a terrific First Gentleman he would make, giving the American people funny and touching insights into their beautiful, blended family and what makes the Vice President such a special person and inspirational leader. And then, Barack Obama and Michelle Obama each made the case with grace, humor, eloquence, and forcefulness – as only they can – for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and against four more dangerous years of Donald Trump.
As Michelle Obama said, “Hope is making a comeback.” President Obama wove a story of change begun during his administration through the historic achievements under President Biden, looking forward with hope and optimism to the promise of a Harris-Walz administration. The chants of “Yes she can” shook the United Center.
All that came after a rollicking roll call of states. No other state could match the historic firsts of the Bay State or our incredible lineup of Democratic elected leaders. Our delegation showed up and showed off.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Screenshot%202024-08-21%20at%2011.52.45%E2%80%AFAM.png] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Screenshot%202024-08-21%20at%2012.20.21%E2%80%AFPM.png]
This morning, at our delegation breakfast, we had another incredible lineup of speakers: Senator Tim Kaine of Virginia, Jaime Harrison, national Chair of the Democratic Party, Chrissy Lynch, President of the MA AFL-CIO, Boston Mayor Michelle Wu, Attorney General Andrea Campbell, Congresswomen Ayanna Pressley and Katherine Clark, as well as our elected neighbors from Maine, Governor Janet Mills and Secretary of State Shenna Bellows.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_0826.jpeg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/GVhFSq4WwAAH0qv.jpg] [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/IMG_0840.jpeg]
Tonight, we're excited to hear from President Bill Clinton and others, with the highlight to be the acceptance speech of the next Vice President of the United States, Governor Tim Walz.
If last night inspired you to take up Michelle Obama’s challenge to “Do Something,” you can take action today by splitting a donation between MassDems and the Harris [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/massdemsxharris]
Victory Fund [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/massdemsxharris] or signing up to volunteer at https://www.mobilize.us/massdems/ [https://www.mobilize.us/massdems/]
We also have some exciting new Massachusetts for Harris and Harris/Walz merch in our webstore! [https://store.massdems.org/]
Onward,
The Massachusetts Democratic Party

| Hi Friend,
When President Obama spoke at the Democratic Convention last night, he had a clear message for all of us: "America's ready for a new chapter." As Texans, we know this to be particularly true. We're ready for a new chapter. We're ready for "a better story."
But our representatives in Washington, folks like 11-time incumbent John Carter, just aren't in step with the rest of us anymore. They've stopped fighting for the hardworking families here.
It's time for a new brand of leadership, a new day for Texas-31.
Stuart Whitlow is ready to be that leader, for all of us. Our campaign is building one of the broadest coalitions we've ever seen -- that means Stuart's welcoming lifelong Democrats alongside Republicans and independent voters, because they just can't buy our opponent's out-of-date vision for the future, and his inability to fully represent this district, any longer.
Stuart's got a clear vision for how to make Congress get back to work for working Texans. But he can't win this alone. This is about all of us, and all our families.

Or, to borrow a phrase from Michelle Obama, we started COURIER because we believe hope is ready for a comeback. Since 2015, Donald Trump has skillfully manipulated cable news outlets like CNN and Fox News to spread dangerous lies and hate. He won in 2016 because the media prioritized ratings and profits over truth, leaving our country forever changed. 8 years later, the media hasn't changed very much. | | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

body:
| | | Peter, The Democratic National Convention is happening _right now_ in Chicago and we have an exciting opportunity to come together, watch, and reflect on this pivotal moment in our nation’s history. **[RSVP to join us »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxBzaS91w6tzO1ZxmbFAXzPVaBewDi71VUAisMbtstXr9NAXnPEWTCKcwuIq83PkOUoNu6Cou-kU3o3_owILRlOrq6Pr-7M2Cxdd8EmtAYHfSdiXHIde_1U92UW0SMooqJCJ-k4Ut5tBJi46hd98sVQZr8g5piLNsLgh8WlOHDyA5baVHKWmAPD2b9mXPLS_cOWcQ2ZcPz8-sQrMosAfoGZ36ys8MbvyeN2peUTHoC3Gbod8mwVDNgun6GGmPzWOBR/493/MhqN4eqiSLKDLst8GmK19g/h0/h001.6n34hMv96CfgfuYPNXXYKe_JPeehTwzO_JdH7Yv2CPg)** **[Join us this Thursday, August 22nd, around 10 PM ET, as we watch Democratic nominee for president Kamala Harris deliver her primetime acceptance speech to the nation at the DNC.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxBzaS91w6tzO1ZxmbFAXzPVaBewDi71VUAisMbtstXr9NAXnPEWTCKcwuIq83PkOUEJ-qE5W9mm8hMCKGfLWw44fJUc0WbB9t46sxsY0e7ZRYTyxhDFOCYd1h_FMNShwSTiNKU-p2W48AMtwRd_v1ci-v0BvKXXGJ_EDleWkkSYZnoELsuj3T_vXNdVeaQVxfzxCv_RrQvblid-FIn3SXfh1RRvQRKy12S-4tWQ8A7KHhQiMoIbawzOYfJF0pPs4v/493/MhqN4eqiSLKDLst8GmK19g/h1/h001.Z6N7hL9CMwO3di3piwe3auyiFeFEmwBrx9jrZpFrMiU)** Let’s experience this powerful moment in community, surrounded virtually by others who care deeply about the future of working people. But the conversation doesn’t end there. **On Friday, August 23rd at 1 PM ET, we invite you to join us _again_ for a dynamic and thought-provoking discussion on what we’ve seen and heard this week, and what it means for our movement.** This panel will feature an incredible lineup of grassroots leaders, including **WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell, Adrienne Maree Brown, Rukia Lumumba, Dawn Phillips, Hillary Holley, and Greisa Martinez Rosas.** Together, we’ll ground ourselves in our movement and explore where working people fit into the larger narratives expressed this week from the stage of and amongst the delegates to the Democratic National Convention. We’ll discuss the strategies we need to achieve collective freedom and ensure everyone has the opportunity to live well and thrive. **[RSVP to join us »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxBzaS91w6tzO1ZxmbFAXzPVaBewDi71VUAisMbtstXr9NAXnPEWTCKcwuIq83PkOUeXOjxcdpge3mXrvDLTbkxVK0nMx44-_VVOfokp6Tef9i9FeDdOYBASsUO2IQfb2Do4yw6RYsVOiz7VEV8f9vraQUGxBzll8cgK8I62mycNQSu4zL-hMI-xAOdyAw64MpprGuOyew_h9DwHNt5AQFRopy81NMRX81ETd6Vr5kHp0JlJNTVQ2YJgwlrtzgMxHy/493/MhqN4eqiSLKDLst8GmK19g/h2/h001.o24G_mOA8JT3vACmDwiznu_SN8_gblut_iYbkIdlAio)** These two events are more than just an opportunity to watch history together – they are a chance to make meaning in community and envision the future we want to build. Where do we all fit into this movement? Let’s find out together.
* **Thursday, August 22nd around 10 PM ET/9 PM CT:** Watch Party – Kamala Harris’ DNC Primetime Speech
* **Friday, August 23rd at 1 PM ET/noon CT:** Post-DNC Panel Discussion with Adrienne Maree Brown and other grassroots leaders

[These are both events you won’t want to miss. We hope you’ll join us, and invite your friends to do so as well! Let’s come together and chart the path forward for working people through November and beyond.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxBzaS91w6tzO1ZxmbFAXzPVaBewDi71VUAisMbtstXr9NAXnPEWTCKcwuIq83PkOU70315wl9f6QElWOve01qHy8uuR37greKVObc7Ad7kf8G-yESX3uP4KnMEe1jqjJptWVvBIxpX_3_VcMz-loRHhuyfHqgshwUby5gOTLdVzyaD07EJXN5olX9Z4ZIwjOYzlawpOzWSI5wEI4H3NfZVzLgNRtWjXnmp8yzVOzwQBkgMcYFJSGM-_uqLEk8slyZ/493/MhqN4eqiSLKDLst8GmK19g/h3/h001.NelGD5mf-mOXVm0V7qy95tbMswqNuyodks3lmeOVRE0) Looking forward to seeing you there! clean_body: | | | Peter, The Democratic National Convention is happening right now in Chicago and we have an exciting opportunity to come together, watch, and reflect on this pivotal moment in our nation’s history. Let’s experience this powerful moment in community, surrounded virtually by others who care deeply about the future of working people. But the conversation doesn’t end there. On Friday, August 23rd at 1 PM ET, we invite you to join us again for a dynamic and thought-provoking discussion on what we’ve seen and heard this week, and what it means for our movement. This panel will feature an incredible lineup of grassroots leaders, including WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell, Adrienne Maree Brown, Rukia Lumumba, Dawn Phillips, Hillary Holley, and Greisa Martinez Rosas. Together, we’ll ground ourselves in our movement and explore where working people fit into the larger narratives expressed this week from the stage of and amongst the delegates to the Democratic National Convention. We’ll discuss the strategies we need to achieve collective freedom and ensure everyone has the opportunity to live well and thrive. These two events are more than just an opportunity to watch history together – they are a chance to make meaning in community and envision the future we want to build. Where do we all fit into this movement? Let’s find out together. Thursday, August 22nd around 10 PM ET/9 PM CT: Watch Party – Kamala Harris’ DNC Primetime Speech Friday, August 23rd at 1 PM ET/noon CT: Post-DNC Panel Discussion with Adrienne Maree Brown and other grassroots leaders Looking forward to seeing you there! Peter, We’re facing an appalling reality, and _Mother Jones_ put it perfectly: **“As the Voting Rights Act Nears 60, Conservative Judges Are Gutting It From Every Angle”**
— _Ari Berman of Mother Jones, 8/6/24_ Here’s just a few things that got us to this point:
* _**FIRST:**_ Over a decade ago, the Supreme Court’s _Shelby County_ ruling Team effectively gutted Section 5 of the Voting Rights Act and made it easier for states to make voting harder — particularly for people of color.

* _**THEN:**_ States across the country with histories of racial discrimination were free to jam through harsh voter suppression laws, including strict voter ID requirements, cuts to early voting days, and the removal of ballot drop boxes.

* _**NOW:**_ A recent ruling from the 5th Circuit threatens to further unravel the Voting Rights Act by making it harder to challenge discriminatory maps in court.

**For as long as the Voting Rights Act has been on the books, it’s been under attack.**
Anti-democratic forces have been trying to gain illegitimate, unearned power at the expense of communities of color, especially in the South.
But we’re pushing back. And we have grounds for hope. Last summer, the fair maps movement won big at the Supreme Court in _Allen v. Milligan_. The ruling protected Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act and led to new maps across the region. Alabama, Louisiana, and Georgia all have new maps that feature additional districts where Black voters can elect candidates of their choice.

Today, as I attend the Democratic National Convention, the Nasturtiums I planted are in full bloom. What a metaphor - as they symbolize victory in struggle and deep patriotism. Friends,
Reuters recently named this seat “one to watch” and it’s clear Trump has his eye on NY-1. Why? No, he’s not looking at real estate – it’s because one of his flunkies is flailing here.
Can Trump count on Nick? Of course he can. Can Nick count on Trump? That tends to not end well. But MAGA Mike Johnson knows his majority is at stake, and he’ll spend whatever it takes to try to keep his job, too. No wonder Nick’s word doesn’t count for much - he’s already outsourced his conscience and common sense to do whatever Donald Trump says.
Those are the stakes, folks. We’re facing an avalanche of dark money and we’ve got less than 80 days to try to beat it. We need your help. If you haven’t yet, can you pitch in and help us fight back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=0820]

Trump-aligned dark money groups are spending nearly $700k as you’re reading this to prop up their toady Nick LaLota – because they know he’s toast without it.
This is not a sign of strength - it’s a sign of weakness. How many other incumbents are spending desperately right now to try to hold onto their seat?
Not many. It’s because Nick’s scared and going to every right-wing group he can find, hat in hand, promising his unending loyalty in exchange for keeping his no-show job. Long Island can do better than that. Help us fight back >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=0820]

Trump and his obedient Speaker Mike Johnson are going to stop at nothing to try to save one of their own. Flunkies gonna flunky, right?
A lot of things suddenly make a LOT more sense. Like, why would Nick LaLota help torpedo a bipartisan border security bill led by a conservative Senator? Because he was told to.
Why does he break his promises to us? Because he was told to.
Now those same special interests Nick’s offering a bailout are coming in to try to help him save his seat. Don’t fall for it. It’s not Nick’s seat. It belongs to the people of Suffolk County. They deserve someone who’ll keep their promises.
That’s what’s at stake this November. We’ve got to win back this seat. Help make it happen >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-general?refcode=0820]

This is not a sign of strength - it’s a sign of weakness. How many other incumbents are spending desperately right now to try to hold onto their seat? Not many. And I get it, friend. Most days, you're much more likely to find me in a Guardians sweatshirt or T-shirt than a suit and tie.

I'm running for reelection to continue fighting for the Dignity of Work – all work. Whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, work for tips or earn a salary, are raising children or caring for an aging parent, I'll fight for you. # The Disgrace of Burning the American Flag
### They should all go to prison in my humble opinion!!
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Aug 21
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
The American flag represents the principles of liberty, justice, and unity that this country was founded upon. It is a testament to the struggles and triumphs of generations who have fought to uphold these values. To burn the flag is not only an act of desecration but a direct insult to every American who cherishes the ideals it represents.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3aefddae-f7ce-4794-afe4-82596571319c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe those who engage in such acts should face severe consequences. Burning the flag is a cowardly attempt to sow division and disrespect the sacrifices of our veterans and service members.
It's time for our laws to reflect the gravity of this offense and ensure that those who desecrate the flag are held accountable. We must protect the dignity of our national symbols and uphold the values that make America great.

# About Last Night...
---
| I made a last-minute decision tocome to the DNC because I knew that I could make important connections here to build upon the strong momentumof our campaign to Flip Chip!
I came here without a plan, knowing that sometimes things come together in unexpected ways.
Yesterday was one of those days, filled with what can only be described as **campaign magic**.
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=9fd3e46469&e=395a33a3d2)
| With a little help from a friend, I attended the convention last night and got to see the Obamas speak in their hometown!!
What an absolute JOY it was!They lit up the room, andevery single seat was full!
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=e50749f228&e=395a33a3d2)
| The center is gigantic, y’all! And I’d be lying if I said I didn’t get lost in there. But that’s when the magic happened!
As I was wandering the concourse, I ran into a guy who I was in Teach For America with in New York City 15 years ago!!
Like me, he taught middle school science.And like me, he is running for Congress now!!!
Tony Vargas is currently a repin his home state of Nebraska, and I couldn’t be more proud to see where he has landed since our years of public service as teachers in NYC.
---

_Just like us._
To steal a maxim from the Kendall County Dems, **there are more of us than you know!**
I am so happy to be in this fightat this pivotal moment in our nation’s history —but I truly can’t do it alone!

subject: What Trump said in Michigan yesterday
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1805%2E135344%2Ezh_7KP)

Friend --
Yesterday, Donald Trump and our opponent, Mike Rogers, campaigned in my district, in Howell, Michigan. Right now, Americans are desperate for leaders who will bring us together around a hopeful vision of the future. But Trump didn’t come here to bring people together, call out hateful behavior, or offer any kind of hopeful vision for our country.
Instead, he spent his time here lying about the deadliness of the January 6th insurrection, implying that outside police forces should patrol the city of Detroit during the election this year, peddling lies about union workers, and repeatedly attacking Kamala Harris.
This won’t be the last time we see Donald Trump here in Michigan, spewing lies about our state and its people.
Because Trump knows what we know: He can’t win the White House – and Republicans can’t flip the Senate – without winning Michigan. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
Trump’s visit is further indication that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.
No matter what anyone may tell you, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. And political forecasters have said Michigan is a pure toss up.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day.
Because just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right back.

body:

#
Did you catch Sarah on CNN last night?!
Sarah is in the Windy City at the Democratic National Convention, where hope and history are in the air!
She joined CNN before last night’s electrifying roll call to reflect on this historical week to nominate Kamala Harris as the first Black and South Asian presidential nominee — and **Sarah’s own history-making race as she runs to become the first out trans member of Congress!**
📺 [**Watch the interview — then pitch in $5 to help send Sarah to Congress, where she’ll make history this November:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240821-1?refcode=em20240821-1-1046&amount=5&refcode2=1046_21716_bQFJE8&akid=1046%2E21716%2EbQFJE8)

**[Watch now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240821-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240821-1-1046&refcode2=1046_21716_bQFJE8&akid=1046%2E21716%2EbQFJE8)**
**Sarah is no stranger to firsts.**
In 2012, Sarah was the first openly trans woman to work at the White House, as an intern for President Obama.
In 2016, she was the first openly trans person to speak at the Democratic National Convention.
And in 2020, Sarah became the first openly trans person elected to a State Senate, chosen by her neighbors in the first district of Delaware (which just so happens to be the first state to have signed the U.S. Constitution).
Now, as she runs for Congress, we have the opportunity to shatter a national lavender glass ceiling — **but she can’t do it without you!**
[**Will you pitch in $5 to Sarah’s historic campaign and help send her to Congress where she’ll not only make history, she’ll make a difference on issues of consequence — from affordable health care and housing to paid leave and more?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240821-1?refcode=em20240821-1-1046&amount=5&refcode2=1046_21716_bQFJE8&akid=1046%2E21716%2EbQFJE8)

Hey Peter, greetings from the Democratic National Convention! | Hey Peter, greetings from the Democratic National Convention! I’ve been here in Chicago since Sunday night, and in that time I’ve met 🔥 hundreds of fired-up Democrats 🔥 and been part of exciting conversations about our path forward. Everyone is prepared to do the work. Everyone is ready to build a brighter future. Folks, I worked for President Obama in 2008 and traveled all over the country with him. I wasn’t sure I’d ever feel energy and positivity like that in politics again, but it’s exactly what I’m feeling this week. As Michelle Obama put it last night, hope is making a comeback! The right people. A positive vision. And the energy to organize and fight. We need all three to win in November, and after these few days in Chicago, I’m feeling more hopeful than ever that we’re ready to deliver all three in North Carolina. One might even say I’m filled with... a new hope... I’ll share a longer update on my time here once I’m back home in North Carolina, so please stay tuned. **In the meantime, send me a reply to this email, and let me know what you’ve loved at the DNC this week and how you’re feeling about November!** Thanks so much. I’ll be in touch again soon. — Wiley

name: Shawnna Bolick
subject: I'm proud of what we've accomplished
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4cbc04025c&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,
I have been extremely busy since winning our primary and gearing up for the state’s toughest State Senate race to maintain the majority. If I don’t win, the State Senate will be tied 15-15. Arizona can’t afford to have a future without school choice or low taxes. Mark my word, the Democrats will raise your taxes and whittle down our student’s current educational options.

This week SPN is in town. I have enjoyed hearing about policy solutions being used in other states. It has been great to refuel and learn about innovative ideas to solve some of our state’s growing problems.

It was nice to stop by SPN and see some old friends and make some new acquaintances as well. Like old and new friendships, to be successful in winning a campaign, it is all about addition, not subtraction.

Many people have asked me this week if I have set aside time to listen to the democrat convention. No, I haven’t been watching the DNC Convention, but I do hear clips on the radio and see their speeches posted online. The democrat whose name will be listed at the top of the ticket has supported horrible policies leading to chaos and homelessness in some of our largest cities in America. Vice President Harris has complained about inflation, but hasn’t done anything to solve it. The VP is the deciding vote in the US Senate if they need her to step in, right, and she is now on the campaign trail complaining about inflation. The Democrats have allowed rampant illegal immigration, transnational gangs, illicit drugs, and crime to overtake our streets.

_With all this being stated, the Democrats are energized right now._

Thankfully, republicans offer a more positive message. To win this down ballot race, we need every resource we can pull into our campaign.

_The Bolick Brigade needs you. _

Do you have time to write post cards?
Can you send text messages to help with our Get out the vote apparatus?
Would you like to help us make phone calls to chase early mail-in ballots?
Can you help with a literature drop in your precinct?
Can you host a meet and greet?
If you answered yes to any of these questions, just reply to this email how you’d like to help, and we will put you to work.

If you live in LD2, I would be honored if you could put up a [yard sign](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5ebb6c5c1d&e=a7ab36849c) endorsing us for the November 5th election.

Your support adds up and will fuel our campaign to the end.

We are finalizing our budget. If you would like to [invest](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ae1d0430fd&e=a7ab36849c) in saving this state, I am the hardest campaigner and have a stellar legislative track record.

Since I was first elected in November 2018, I have been a champion for small business, lean government, and secure borders. In 2024, with a democrat governor in office I had several pieces of legislation signed into law. My leftwing democrat opponent has yet to have a single bill signed even with a democrat governor.

As a wife, mom, and champion for hardworking families throughout Arizona, I have spent my career fighting for educational freedom. At the Capitol, I have led the charge in stopping inflation on food, gas, and rent, protecting our children, countering fentanyl abuse, and working to end human trafficking.

I will continue to fight for common-sense solutions to the challenges facing our community, from standing up for veterans to protecting our water supply. We have all witnessed the consequences of single party rule, which is why keeping a check on the Governor’s agenda provides more balanced policy for our communities. Together, we will build safer neighborhoods, strong schools, and great jobs.

I have been endorsed by law enforcement, small businesses, and teachers. I won’t let you down.

I have enjoyed helping my constituents navigate complex issues and overseeing them until they are in the rearview mirror.

Near the end of my July 30th primary, my car died, so I have been renting a small SUV so they can fix the steering and who knows what else in their diagnostic report. This has not stopped me from campaigning in the blistering heat. My husband and others can attest I had a heat rash during the primary, and it still hasn’t dissipated this month.

I look forward to serving two more years as your State Senator. As a mom, I better finish loading up my rental car to lend our daughter a hand to move her back to campus this morning.

Thank you for your continued support!

Take care,
Shawnna

Letting criminals run free with the soft-on-crime Biden Administration. Leaving our border WIDE OPEN. Raking in big dollars from special interests while everyday Virginians suffer under inflation. Tim Kaine is watching from his ivory tower as our Commonwealth and our country burn. While playing his harmonica, and he couldn’t care less. You won’t see me in an ivory tower blowing anything. I’ve served in combat all over the world, when I’m in the United States Senate, I’ll fight every day for what hardworking Americans need! This is our chance to TAKE BACK Virginia and TAKE BACK our Senate majority. But if we’re going to beat Tim Kaine, we need all hands on deck. ************ In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret) | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

Friends,
This week at the DNC Convention, the message has been clear: flipping the House isn’t just about defeating the ULTRA-MAGA agenda; it’s about taking bold action for working families, protecting our rights, and moving our country forward.
In her economic speech last Friday, Vice President Kamala Harris laid out a powerful vision for what a Democratic majority can achieve.
With a Democratic House and Senate, a Harris-Walz presidency can deliver on the things that matter most to Americans—starting with protecting reproductive rights.
Harris made it clear that under her leadership, we will fight to codify Roe v. Wade and ensure every woman has the right to make decisions about her own body without government interference.
But protecting reproductive rights isn’t just a national issue—it’s deeply personal to me as a reproductive freedom fighter.
I’m taking on one of the most dangerous men in Congress, Jim Jordan, to flip the House and ensure we have leaders who respect our rights. The road to a Democratic majority runs through Ohio, and together, we can shut the door on Jim Jordan’s harmful agenda once and for all. If you believe in this fight as much as I do, please contribute today to help us win. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240821_flip_the_house_link1]
Vice President Harris also outlined plans to lower costs for working families by capping prescription drug prices, making housing more affordable, and ensuring that no one has to choose between paying rent and putting food on the table.
A Democratic majority means we can tackle these issues head-on and deliver real results for the people.
Several speakers at the DNC Convention have reminded us that down-ballot races are just as important as the presidency.
We have a real chance to flip Ohio’s 4th District and send Jim Jordan home for good.
Make no mistake, thanks to your support and the energy on the ground – Ohio is back in play.
This fall, we can not only defeat the clowns pushing their extreme, outdated agenda—we can go on the offensive for working people, securing a future where everyone has a fair shot.
This is our moment to make history.
If you believe in a brighter future for Ohio and America, contribute to our campaign today. Help us flip the house for the Harris/Walz ticket and bring about the change we all deserve. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240821_flip_the_house_link2]

Tamie Wilson

Representative Jason Crow says that securing our border and stopping the flow of illegal weapons and drugs into our country is a priority but believes that a border wall will be ineffective and that **immigration detention or deportation is not necessary**. Crow has been in office since January 3, 2019 and since then, more than **_10,351,846_** illegal aliens have flooded our streets.

Crow's inaction in Congress has created **rampant lawlessness** at our southern border and allowed violent criminals and terrorists into our country. Earlier this year, a young woman by the name of Laken Riley was tragically murdered by someone who was in this country illegally. **Crow voted against H.R. 7511** \- **The Laken Riley Act which would have ended the catch-and-release of criminal illegal aliens.** Just over a week ago, a grandmother was fatally killed in a carjacking involving an illegal immigrant who even had a California driver's license. Crow's all-bark-no-bite attitude towards the border crisis has allowed fentanyl to explode all across our country, including here in Colorado. In our state, fentanyl-related overdose deaths have exploded to 59% and is the _leading cause of death_ for those aged 18 to 45. Not only is this affecting adults, but our kids are increasingly dying due to smuggled fentanyl. Nationwide, the fentanyl being smuggled into our country is the cause of 84% of teenage drug overdoses.**Jason Crow** **voted against H.R. 467 - the HALT Fentanyl Act** which would have placed a 10-year mandatory minimum prison term on offenses involving the sale of Fentanyl. Colorado's 6th District and the U.S. **need strong representatives** on the border like John Fabbricatore, not someone like Jason Crow who follows the party line and votes in line with Nancy Pelosi and other far-left lawmakers.

And it’s what polls are showing our campaign is ahead by now. _Just one percentage point._ **This margin in this race is razor-thin — but the difference between Kirsten and her opponent, Juan Ciscomani, is bigger than the Grand Canyon. ** ✅ Kirsten is unapologetically pro-choice.

[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=f370d9e6bf0841a18534a419e8d1605b&_e=Ug1z7nbF7EOZl3Ua0I18BCpWXRZGob0PdFTNGSno6q-97abNFqkLF1q-UfbxJNedA63T3oYVh6uycBaiDhjQ1aFVvVBrBxKjNzJ77RoF66T-iqeDGpFE1jeywpsltRSvB2IYJvdQjzfNwDOtwmjkVCLcl4_isHmov_8tGvMEs6W5C-d8DTafhC1zynEtmPHeWqXyIIWm7sbwjEe2wywtyGT6sYUh4NErtr4JSWTeZeydGx7TVCD_jNyqY55ZezPe8SwCQ_sGal8mFHc9uBnPCTE8ICOC41qaI4Ev8lPW8k1p81acjFOM5CBrQPJCmIiH07OStuOS9Lfc1iyfdDIc464IoVRHQa3m1v8urUwH9D2qSnIRtDyAJib_LsJEHDPb)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=f370d9e6bf0841a18534a419e8d1605b&_e=Ug1z7nbF7EOZl3Ua0I18BCpWXRZGob0PdFTNGSno6q-97abNFqkLF1q-UfbxJNedA63T3oYVh6uycBaiDhjQ1aFVvVBrBxKjNzJ77RoF66T-iqeDGpFE1jeywpsltRSvB2IYJvdQjzfNwDOtwmjkVCLcl4_isHmov_8tGvMEs6W5C-d8DTafhC1zynEtmPHeWqXyIIWm7sbwjEe2wywtyLbQhkQSjHbXet08owCzrvFsvcLYo0voIcgu0CQK0KC84jrpS5L365XONIJfvbFx7B4jm_wGUB-ePJu5egNOCtGjRoJJcJA0kwPvO-FFMx7arJksBIsCHufQKmYt_X-rVjWmSPeJP_esYLMQiXmKPyZy_mJRBqyVd80u7kEdA8fp)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=f370d9e6bf0841a18534a419e8d1605b&_e=Ug1z7nbF7EOZl3Ua0I18BCpWXRZGob0PdFTNGSno6q-97abNFqkLF1q-UfbxJNedA63T3oYVh6uycBaiDhjQ1aFVvVBrBxKjNzJ77RoF66T-iqeDGpFE1jeywpsltRSvB2IYJvdQjzfNwDOtwmjkVCLcl4_isHmov_8tGvMEs6W5C-d8DTafhC1zynEtmPHeWqXyIIWm7sbwjEe2wywtyC1QVeRKsGVRRpAc-wWsY3uVQnD5ytk4ZRBHmT1NBmdO594jD_jltccUMbXs4GqdbutzcS2r3SGtAfjzu56rGU3BrPS1cBEKakHWXp-mak4SoCfFdYueLE2Pe_fcOZpZPDWDh5GQEtKwORuCBWcY8pcI99tXBU-z_wlTXIPBvksd) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=f370d9e6bf0841a18534a419e8d1605b&_e=Ug1z7nbF7EOZl3Ua0I18BCpWXRZGob0PdFTNGSno6q-97abNFqkLF1q-UfbxJNedA63T3oYVh6uycBaiDhjQ1aFVvVBrBxKjNzJ77RoF66T-iqeDGpFE1jeywpsltRSvB2IYJvdQjzfNwDOtwmjkVCLcl4_isHmov_8tGvMEs6W5C-d8DTafhC1zynEtmPHeWqXyIIWm7sbwjEe2wywtyF4-LrWjUg1UG_hcjMurCiAmLLeydNRBojRoXEtdnjgn9kgoNdTRKyYQdvK3j0kLOitqXw64AEB24hVTWq-IP20jmnsUFTlzC8gLKITDEJdfQpDWMdkxhUvZesS6Tn7nG9eLjxJCH0TKEHDdaP-2MQUKujPSEaIK_S0J4cKCcyl_)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**

body:
...and Republicans like Josh Hawley abandoned veterans like me
#
Peter — I’m Lt. Col. Lucas Kunce, USMCR, 13 years of active duty.
**After three tours of duty in Iraq and Afghanistan, I never imagined I would return home and face more attacks.** But that’s what happened two years ago, when Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68487?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68487?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44)
**Let me tell you what happened, so you know why I’m running for U.S. Senate.**
In Iraq, I deployed to the Sunni Triangle where I led a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman, running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi. **From our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.**
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68487?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44)
When I got home from that deployment, I had developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. **And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits.** Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt when politicians who have never worn the uniform, like Josh Hawley, threw us a giant middle finger and voted against aid for veterans who were exposed to these toxic burn pits.
I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**[If you’re with me, will you please consider donating $10 or anything at all so we can get this message in front of voters and defeat Josh Hawley this November? I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs in this race, so any amount you can give will have a massive impact on our grassroots campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68487?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=5&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=6&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=7&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=8&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=9&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68488?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=10&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/68487?refcode=em20240821-7412&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=7412%2E614464%2Eq9hg44)

Thank you so much.
Lucas Kunce

I am now the official Democratic nominee in a race that could determine which party will control the Senate.
I couldn't have gotten this far without supporters like you, and as we enter the final lap of the race, your continued support is the only way I'll win: Especially when recent polls show this race statistically tied.

I need my message to beat his to the chase, and I can't do that without you.
So with the primary behind us, the real battle begins now — and I'm counting on 20,000 supporters getting on board by midnight to show the GOP that our grassroots movement is unstoppable. #
Dear Friend,

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Despite the Supreme Court ruling in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Planned Parenthood continues to receive taxpayer funding, effectively subsidizing the intentional killing of preborn children. Since 2000, nearly $10.7 billion of taxpayers' money has funded their life-ending work.

Contrast this with the nearly 3,000 Pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide dedicated to supporting expectant mothers. Planned Parenthood only operates about 600 facilities and primarily offers one service: abortion. Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. Sign our petition before midnight to demand an end to this grave misuse of your taxes. **[https://www.liveaction.org/defund-planned-parenthood-petition/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=656f43ec215343cab16558edc57d1d7e&_e=xcYtYppdOrgsZFD7pLgyPKrXJJriINeb3iktbKH1LkNoojIaD2GeQURiQ14H5jopDwA3TeOOG5I8N67VdrqnVHZMIS-VAWtWfEA2P3herbxSC_U0d1QI__CFL8vlzwGk8tGHIwcxCgs2WRu6arFKqlYdENGMXb5KeVcXaAgRyIAnyjE8SvvmQxqehWA5cFf0N6lAngVdYxALqFDLtuEaqc2qtVtX0pdXQJ9x50ERFLG_3AkEcqU7rtMPcoS-9T1AQISc3DtQizeWNnQ3vN3pZeuFsleJVOjmmAF3PX-h2XVwp7AYCtHXvZmi1tjK2ryDic7oQabDX9fanu2xgRUl7vnF0eweQisQfAiD_Fh-eTy47qWFrx6cdhXh24LJuNqmC1imUTztf_9QJcAYC-eWBA%3D%3D)**

Thank you for standing with us for the protection of future generations!

For Life,

Lila Rose

Updates for the 25th District - Aug 21st| | |
---
# **August 21st Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | I hope parents and students alike had a happy first day of school! As the 2024/2025 school year begins in Prince William County, I want to express gratitude to our teachers, administrative staff, crossing guards, bus drivers, and everyone else who works so hard to ensure our young people get a quality education in a safe and supportive environment.
---
I had the privilege to greet students and parents at Springwoods Elementary School upon their arrival this Monday. Principal Mainor was kind enough to let me pop into the kindergarten classrooms, where students were already hard at work. This was incredibly special since I had the opportunity to visit students in the same classroom where I attended kindergarten myself! Principal Mainor and her staff have created a warm and welcoming environment for every student who enters the building. I am happy to report " It's All Good in the Woods!"
---
---
As you continue to read this newsletter, you will find information regarding AmeriCorps, the WoodbridgeNaz Foodbank renovation, the signing of my bill, House Bill 739, and the Investiture of Judge Kiah Spinks.
---
| |
# **AmeriCorps at CASA**
---
| |
---
| I was honored to speak at the 2023/2024 AmeriCorps graduation at the CASA Welcome Center last week. This year’s cohort was comprised of nine individuals, many with personal ties to Prince William County. These individuals spent the past year dedicating themselves to serving immigrant communities in the region and were recognized for their impactful and selfless work.
---
Several cohort members were recognized for their work closing the digital literacy gap by creating a computer training course, facilitating a life-skill/college readiness course, and starting an English-language book club to help ESL speakers.
---
| | Other AmeriCorps grads were celebrated for their work assisting tax preparation for immigrant families to help first-time applicants navigate the tax code. I am grateful for the service these dedicated individuals have given to the community and was proud to celebrate their hard work this past year.
---
| | AmeriCorps is the federal agency for national service and volunteerism. AmeriCorps provides opportunities for Americans of all backgrounds to serve their country, address the nation’s most pressing challenges, and improve lives and communities. AmeriCorps volunteers help with disaster services, education, environmental stewardship, health services, economic assistance, and assistance to veteran and military families.

# **WoodbridgeNaz Foodbank Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony & Tour**
---
| |
---
| Last week, I was excited to join Woodbridge Church of the Nazarene for the ribbon cutting of their new food bank facilities. WoodbridgeNaz has been feeding households for 20 years, and helped address tremendous need during the Covid-19 pandemic. WoodbridgeNaz partners with NoVA food rescue, Capital Area Food Bank, and Sentara Care to provide a scalable operation. With the assistance of these partners, as well as allocated funding from the American Rescue Act, WoodbridgeNaz now has a walk-in refrigerator and freezer and a full kitchen, which allows them to provide fresh produce in a scalable and sanitary way.
---
| | I’m incredibly grateful to the congregation members, volunteers, and program partners who make the WoodbridgeNaz foodbank possible. Over the course of the program’s life, they have fed an estimated 39,000 households, and exemplify what is possible with healthy partnerships between nonprofit agencies. You can find more information about food pantry schedule here: [https://www.woodbridgenaz.com/foodpantry](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91264058/493261909/633285357?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NGIzNTZjZi1mYjVmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LuTO6TmKK9ET0YcCfeKwIolizKUtmSrV9DyeKKuS6iI=&emci=5d3285ae-0f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=44b356cf-fb5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801)
---
|

| |
# **Bill Signing: Addressing Military Families Child Care Needs**
---
| |
---
| On Wednesday of last week the Governor ceremonially signed my bill, [House Bill 739](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91264059/493261910/599157503?usp=drive_link&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NGIzNTZjZi1mYjVmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LuTO6TmKK9ET0YcCfeKwIolizKUtmSrV9DyeKKuS6iI=&emci=5d3285ae-0f5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=44b356cf-fb5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=21796801), into law. House Bill 739 addresses the child care provider crisis for military families by allowing DOD-licensed family child care providers to skip the duplicative and time-intensive process of getting licensed by the state of Virginia on top of the more rigorous DOD licensure.
---
| | Family child care workers provide military families with reliable and personalized care in a homelike setting, on and off military installations. These providers, the majority of whom are military spouses (87% in fiscal year 2021), operate as independent business owners, contributing to the financial stability of their families. When moving with their service member, family child care providers do not have to complete additional training or an additional background check when they arrive at their new installation, unless their certification is due for renewal. The latest installation commander grants providers certification upon completion of the required home inspections. Prior to the passage of House Bill 739, the Commonwealth of Virginia required licensure or registration for some on-installation and all off-installation family child care providers — which is duplicative of the military service certification process. This often delayed a provider from issuing child care, which can create financial hardship for a military spouse who needs to re-establish a business after a military move. By exempting family child care providers already certified through the military service process, the Commonwealth of Virginia enhances the quality of life and economic security of both the providers and military families seeking qualified child care options while increasing the overall supply of child care available to families in need. While I am pleased to have addressed this barrier to childcare for our military families, there is still work to be done. My original version of House Bill 739 contained language to ensure that all U.S. Department of Defense approved childcare is exempt from additional Virginia licensing, but sadly this language did not make it into the final bill. I will always fight for our active duty service members and veterans, and look forward to resolving this gap of approximately 1300 families in a timely manner.
---
| |
# **Investiture Ceremony for Judge Kiah Spinks**
---
| | **DID YOU KNOW?** In the Commonwealth of Virginia, judges are selected for the bench through legislative action. The judicial selection process begins when a vacancy occurs in the judiciary or when a new seat is created by the General Assembly. Last October, based upon analysis from the Committee on District Courts an additional judgeship for the Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court of the 31st Judicial District was recommended.
---
| | On Friday, August 16th, I participated in the investiture of Judge Kiah Spinks, the newest Presiding Judge to the Juvenile and Domestic Relations Court. It was truly a pleasure to be able to serve as part of the speaking program and witness the installation of Judge Spinks into this esteemed position. (Photo credit R Martin Photos)
---
|
---
| | Throughout her legal career, Judge Spinks has shown unwavering dedication and exceptional leadership as noted by her peers for her demonstrated qualifications and commitment to ensuring litigants are treated with respect and given their fair day in court. But her commitment to the residents of the Greater Prince William Area extends beyond the courtroom. clean_body: Updates for the 25th District - Aug 21st| | | August 21st Newsletter Dear neighbors, | | I hope parents and students alike had a happy first day of school! As the 2024/2025 school year begins in Prince William County, I want to express gratitude to our teachers, administrative staff, crossing guards, bus drivers, and everyone else who works so hard to ensure our young people get a quality education in a safe and supportive environment. I had the privilege to greet students and parents at Springwoods Elementary School upon their arrival this Monday. Principal Mainor was kind enough to let me pop into the kindergarten classrooms, where students were already hard at work. This was incredibly special since I had the opportunity to visit students in the same classroom where I attended kindergarten myself! Principal Mainor and her staff have created a warm and welcoming environment for every student who enters the building. I am happy to report " It's All Good in the Woods!" As you continue to read this newsletter, you will find information regarding AmeriCorps, the WoodbridgeNaz Foodbank renovation, the signing of my bill, House Bill 739, and the Investiture of Judge Kiah Spinks. | | AmeriCorps at CASA | | | I was honored to speak at the 2023/2024 AmeriCorps graduation at the CASA Welcome Center last week. This year’s cohort was comprised of nine individuals, many with personal ties to Prince William County. These individuals spent the past year dedicating themselves to serving immigrant communities in the region and were recognized for their impactful and selfless work. Several cohort members were recognized for their work closing the digital literacy gap by creating a computer training course, facilitating a life-skill/college readiness course, and starting an English-language book club to help ESL speakers. | | Other AmeriCorps grads were celebrated for their work assisting tax preparation for immigrant families to help first-time applicants navigate the tax code. I am grateful for the service these dedicated individuals have given to the community and was proud to celebrate their hard work this past year. | | AmeriCorps is the federal agency for national service and volunteerism. AmeriCorps provides opportunities for Americans of all backgrounds to serve their country, address the nation’s most pressing challenges, and improve lives and communities. AmeriCorps volunteers help with disaster services, education, environmental stewardship, health services, economic assistance, and assistance to veteran and military families. | | If you or someone you know would like to be part of the AmeriCorps 2024-2025 cohort at CASA, you can learn more an apply here: IIP Specialist: to apply: Youth Specialist : to apply: WoodbridgeNaz Foodbank Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony & Tour | | | Last week, I was excited to join Woodbridge Church of the Nazarene for the ribbon cutting of their new food bank facilities. WoodbridgeNaz has been feeding households for 20 years, and helped address tremendous need during the Covid-19 pandemic. WoodbridgeNaz partners with NoVA food rescue, Capital Area Food Bank, and Sentara Care to provide a scalable operation. With the assistance of these partners, as well as allocated funding from the American Rescue Act, WoodbridgeNaz now has a walk-in refrigerator and freezer and a full kitchen, which allows them to provide fresh produce in a scalable and sanitary way. | | I’m incredibly grateful to the congregation members, volunteers, and program partners who make the WoodbridgeNaz foodbank possible. Over the course of the program’s life, they have fed an estimated 39,000 households, and exemplify what is possible with healthy partnerships between nonprofit agencies. You can find more information about food pantry schedule here: | | | Bill Signing: Addressing Military Families Child Care Needs | | | On Wednesday of last week the Governor ceremonially signed my bill, , into law. House Bill 739 addresses the child care provider crisis for military families by allowing DOD-licensed family child care providers to skip the duplicative and time-intensive process of getting licensed by the state of Virginia on top of the more rigorous DOD licensure. | | Family child care workers provide military families with reliable and personalized care in a homelike setting, on and off military installations. These providers, the majority of whom are military spouses (87% in fiscal year 2021), operate as independent business owners, contributing to the financial stability of their families. When moving with their service member, family child care providers do not have to complete additional training or an additional background check when they arrive at their new installation, unless their certification is due for renewal. The latest installation commander grants providers certification upon completion of the required home inspections. Prior to the passage of House Bill 739, the Commonwealth of Virginia required licensure or registration for some on-installation and all off-installation family child care providers — which is duplicative of the military service certification process. This often delayed a provider from issuing child care, which can create financial hardship for a military spouse who needs to re-establish a business after a military move. By exempting family child care providers already certified through the military service process, the Commonwealth of Virginia enhances the quality of life and economic security of both the providers and military families seeking qualified child care options while increasing the overall supply of child care available to families in need. While I am pleased to have addressed this barrier to childcare for our military families, there is still work to be done. My original version of House Bill 739 contained language to ensure that all U.S. Department of Defense approved childcare is exempt from additional Virginia licensing, but sadly this language did not make it into the final bill. I will always fight for our active duty service members and veterans, and look forward to resolving this gap of approximately 1300 families in a timely manner. | | Investiture Ceremony for Judge Kiah Spinks | | DID YOU KNOW? In the Commonwealth of Virginia, judges are selected for the bench through legislative action. Friend,

---
Amidst the Biden-Harris White House’s efforts to utterly ruin me and jail me for life as an innocent man, I wake up in the morning and see headline like these:
---
**_“Giuliani losing his home amidst 2 indictments...”_** _[MSNBC]_
**_“Giuliani bankruptcy case dismissed, opening door to creditors pursuing collection”_** _[CNBC]_
**_“Giuliani Disbarred from the Practice of Law in New York”_** _[New York Times]_

---

---
_...About successfully defending President Trump as his lawyer from one of the Left’s most vicious witch hunts imaginable._
---

subject: Thank you.

body:

| | Peter, First, I am overwhelmingly grateful for your energy and support these past 116 days. My family, team, and I made you a promise that we would run our campaign with the values of service, honor, and character that have defined my military career and life. We did that. While we acknowledged up front that running against an incumbent career politician as a first-time political candidate wasn’t going to be easy, and it wasn’t, I continually drew inspiration from every one of you as you took the time to offer words of encouragement along the way. Your words meant, and will continue to mean, a great deal to me and our family. Thank you so much.
Second, one person I had the incredible fortune to meet when I was in third grade best covered what our campaign was about: “For you see, the character that takes command in moments of crucial choices has already been determined. It has been determined by a thousand other choices made earlier in seemingly unimportant moments. It has been determined by all the ‘little’ choices of
years past – by all those times when the voice of conscience was at war with the voice of temptation – whispering the lie that ‘it really doesn’t matter.’ It has been determined by all the day-to-day
decisions made when life seemed easy and crises seemed far away – the decisions that, piece by piece, bit by bit, developed habits of discipline or of laziness; habits of self-sacrifice or of self-
indulgence; habits of duty and honor and integrity – or dishonor and shame. Because when life does get tough, and the crisis is undeniably at hand – when we must, in an instant, look inward for strength of character to see us through – we will find nothing inside ourselves that we have not already put there.” That person was President Ronald Reagan, and he offered these words during his
commencement speech at The Citadel in 1993. As you keep moving forward, I hope these words inspire you like they have me and my campaign.
Lastly, it was incredibly meaningful to run a race of which my family, my team, and I are most proud. I hope the momentum that our campaign began building here in Florida’s First Congressional
District will continue to swell and ultimately result in bringing more serious leadership and better representation of our citizens to Washington, D.C.

With utmost gratitude,
---
---
**Aaron W. Dimmock**

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Tell the DNC: Reject AIPAC!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

With the 2024 Democratic National Convention underway in Chicago this
week, we haven’t forgotten that right-wing megadonor-funded lobby group
AIPAC successfully infiltrated our Democratic primaries with $25 million
and unseated two progressive incumbents this summer: Reps. Jamaal Bowman
and Cori Bush.

This pro-Israel lobby group bankrolled by the same millionaire and
billionaire donors who support Donald Trump should not have been able to
buy these elections and oust two of the only young, Black, working-class,
progressive leaders we have in Congress.

AIPAC doesn’t just threaten our progressive movement: it threatens the
Party and our democracy in and of itself.

That’s why Justice Democrats is uniting with a coalition of progressive
organizations to call on the Democratic National Committee to finally
reject endorsements and outside spending from AIPAC once and for all.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240821-dnc-reject-aipac/?source=em20240821-35926&akid=35926%2E1203867%2EY1pBiq ]Will you add your name to support our letter to Democratic leadership
calling on the Party to reject AIPAC?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240821-dnc-reject-aipac/?source=em20240821-35926&akid=35926%2E1203867%2EY1pBiq ][IMG]

AIPAC and their allies are spending millions of dollars to defeat
champions of the popular progressive agenda that voters demand and that
help Democrats win, like Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, reproductive
justice, transformative immigration and democracy reform, a lasting
ceasefire, hostage deal, and halt on all weapons funding to the Israeli
military’s assault on Palestinians in Gaza.

It will be significantly more difficult for Democrats to defeat Trump in
November as long as the Party continues to allow GOP-backed PACs and
corporate lobbies to have sway over Democratic politics.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240821-dnc-reject-aipac/?source=em20240821-35926&akid=35926%2E1203867%2EY1pBiq ]As long as AIPAC is allowed to influence our primaries with Republican
dark money, we put our Party and democracy at risk. Help us build the
pressure and urge Democratic leadership to reject AIPAC now →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240821-dnc-reject-aipac/?source=em20240821-35926&akid=35926%2E1203867%2EY1pBiq ]Add Your Name

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: I was just on the floor of the convention
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I wanted to take a second away from all the action to send you a quick message.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240821-4223-footer&t=1&akid=4223%2E420207%2E9saWGC)
Peter,
My schedule today is completely overloaded with meetings and events at the DNC, but I wanted to take a second away from all the action to send you a quick message.
If you’re watching from home, let me tell you — the energy here in Chicago is UNREAL! Democrats are united, ready, and excited to elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz this November. **Personally, I was thrilled to be on the floor last night to officially nominate Kamala as our candidate for president!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240821?refcode=em20240821&amount=3&refcode2=4223_420207_9saWGC&akid=4223%2E420207%2E9saWGC)
But beyond all the excitement, here’s what’s on my mind: there are still **76 days** between now and Election Day. Maintaining all this energy and momentum between now and then is going to be a challenge, and it’s going to take a big grassroots effort to meet the moment.
We’ve got a lot of doors to knock on, phone calls to make, and text messages to send in the next few weeks. But hiring organizers and providing supplies for volunteers costs money, so I’m hoping you can help us with that.

As we prepare to send our kids back to school, we're reminded of the work we still need to do to uplift the next generation. _Our teachers deserve better pay, and our public schools need more support to ensure every child receives the education they deserve._

But while we fight for these improvements, **Donald Trump and his allies have set their sights on something entirely different: dismantling our education system.** They've clung to the dangerous idea of abolishing the Department of Education, threatening to undermine the critical learning our children need to succeed.

**We can't let that happen.**

We need a Democratic House majority this November to stop the GOP's efforts to tear down our education system, and it all starts with holding WA-08. Kim is committed to fighting for our schools, our teachers, and our kids — _but she can't do it alone._

important to remember, Team: During the 2022 midterms, more than one million Pennsylvania voters dropped their ballots in the mail, well in time for them to be counted by Election Day. But several thousand of them were rejected without notice, due to errors with how they dated the hand-written field on the envelope in addition to the date they wrote on the ballot itself.
Yes, to answer the obvious question: PA makes you date the ballot twice . Why? So that people make simple mistakes and give partisans an excuse to toss their ballot. From a news article on the case:
" Pennsylvania voting law requires residents who vote-by-mail to hand write the date they filled out and dropped their ballot in the mailbox on the outside of the envelope. The issue has become a federal case with Republicans and voter advocates asking the U.S. Third Circuit Court of Appeals to decide whether Pennsylvania voters must write accurate mailing dates for their ballots to be accepted - even when the ballot arrives by deadline. "
Opponents of voting rights are trying to get ballots tossed for envelopes with missing or illegible dates on the outside, regardless of how correct things are inside on the ballot itself.
Why is this important? Well, in 2022, one candidate for U.S. Senate received more than 700,000 mailed-in votes than his opponent. That candidate won by less than 300,000 votes, a 5% margin. Several thousand ballots being tossed in a close election this fall could easily swing Pennsylvania's 19 Electoral College votes from one side to the other.

This National Senior Citizens Day, we want to take the time to recognize how the needs of our senior citizens have been overlooked.

Every person deserves the right to retire with dignity. But too many people don’t have that option.

On average, Georgia seniors receive about $1,900 a month from Social Security benefits but the average cost of assisted living is closer to $4,100.

**That’s why it’s a high priority for Rev. Darrius Butler to protect our elders.
