The high costs of senior care doesn’t just end up affecting our seniors — it impacts whole communities.

Aging Americans often have to rely on family members to care for them — moving into their homes or looking for financial support to cover massive assisted living costs.

With the average Georgian making less than $52,000 a year, there is very little left in family budgets to pay for the care of aging parents and grandparents.

**That puts families in the difficult position of choosing between caring for their loved ones and saving for their own futures.

[_This is an issue that impacts _all of us_ in Georgia, and across the country, regardless of age. Like any well-run campaign, we start with an idea of how many votes we need in order to win this race. That's called a "win number."
#

Like any well-run campaign, we start with an idea of how many votes we need in order to win this race. That's called a "win number."
From there, we create a plan and a budget we need to persuade and turnout that number of people who we believe will vote for us, plus a bit of a buffer, of course.
That means every dollar we raise is allocated before it is even spent. When we raise it, we know where it's going and we move it there — taking us closer to what we believe we need to win.
It also means any goals we don't reach mean cuts, putting our ability to reach the "win number" in jeopardy.
When we built our budget, we said we needed a big week this week — capitalizing off enthusiasm of the convention. But right now, we're still not where we need to be. We need to reach our numbers; we don't want to make cuts. So please:

subject: Can you take 1 minute to read this?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers
[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=bdf7d2d96d5d44fd9419da1510bfa483&_e=qe_F8d-pbAjytillnL3QIvxgjnnQjdgWo4U5KcvNSP8sKNZ0WeflEXenYNgPeAkT0OwZKbDH-8dPxC3YTj4TPXRg8Pdet5TjnLWseyJOLGWAH5UTwSbD1S8c3hKVQTQYQVdaM0aohoB1JIjtoaft9rAZsi3xR0-cMD0ggIAXmIa5McCz4UDjMPqh-37lSbXMauj4PgIwZHRzu1JhjkeReYDQWGnm8RIsAlZsSDyYkwujgyflJzvahOT07B9hdWORqiNYDh6YRowhiLjKNZh9EhqGHW5-dqs4KnWNX2fnnUqYR15QasMfUKMQh6YYUyfNiBw6qgKAibWqb0smr91Ug2aLS04yiXhUyiqRzSu0brl9ZtjI6iMyZnJSAAzn3TkDfyAI2Qz5p-13CZrSgNtZJA%3D%3D)

Friend,

As I am on the campaign trail, I'm reminded of the great sacrifices that are made every day to defend our country. Today, I hope you'll take just a few minutes to hear this personal story directly from me.

Nearly four decades ago, during my time at West Point, I came across a book that left a lasting impact on me. **It was "Once an Eagle" by Anton Myrer.**

This powerful story follows the journeys of two Army officers - one who navigated his career driven solely by personal gain and advancement, and one who navigated his career by putting the well-being of his fellow soldiers above all else.

[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=bdf7d2d96d5d44fd9419da1510bfa483&_e=qe_F8d-pbAjytillnL3QIvxgjnnQjdgWo4U5KcvNSP8sKNZ0WeflEXenYNgPeAkT0OwZKbDH-8dPxC3YTj4TPXRg8Pdet5TjnLWseyJOLGWAH5UTwSbD1S8c3hKVQTQYQVdaM0aohoB1JIjtoaft9rAZsi3xR0-cMD0ggIAXmIa5McCz4UDjMPqh-37lSbXMauj4PgIwZHRzu1JhjkeReYDQWGnm8RIsAlZsSDyYkws9OUKYGUmPX3SDyjkLZ6tRMq6zaRTeQUoKU4xT3845GoZzMB8MmaMeZ9cT2h_KdFYIK6JdjWKZkiXK38b7jIgcwOvMh9aRGHx4uvOQ3NcPxE0Hs3nS3bOuM1C59ImGdxs1y0ImphS25Uo70NqwIaGXB3iHbEHuM0oYQvS6wHtAow%3D%3D)

After graduating from West Point, I went into the Army. It was then that I truly reflected on this book and one very important lesson it taught me.

**True leadership is not about you. It is about selfless service to others and to the mission.**

[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=bdf7d2d96d5d44fd9419da1510bfa483&_e=qe_F8d-pbAjytillnL3QIvxgjnnQjdgWo4U5KcvNSP8sKNZ0WeflEXenYNgPeAkT0OwZKbDH-8dPxC3YTj4TPXRg8Pdet5TjnLWseyJOLGWAH5UTwSbD1S8c3hKVQTQYQVdaM0aohoB1JIjtoaft9rAZsi3xR0-cMD0ggIAXmIa5McCz4UDjMPqh-37lSbXMauj4PgIwZHRzu1JhjkeReYDQWGnm8RIsAlZsSDyYkwsZB4WV4naqMYjBZcQWpiLb__BblOQ0P2n4Q9eMeT6pyi4hhpJey0X3DbOOu7_jocK-UBsCws6G5jS6cmiDSqKHQ9uTbHHKHrCUIWbMp07IEF10JfaFgGLoD7NvJM3pvHyUEpohYz8hZzm-d4joRH4iVSUTV8aqGTSrsC4xVHq8mA%3D%3D)

As a combat vet, the days are long and hard. You're deep in the heart of a grueling trek, the weight of your pack bearing down with each step.

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures.
Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=78a0e0d2c75c4c0891554ab821dea124&_e=wOSMG4yBk00K_gMwY4UV3LrSlJIx-z_IKI4_GPQH79wE0EMmY0_LtDEvoPeMMwJQPrHFwRwTtjcqokl5rx6anPfCWrIjPJtvgOHZFaLUtoVuYP8DHJXaaAfyKKLIwHvCxg4rht59Lcv7zgvTCpnZgUmw_-e2_3azMAv782R7zrK77RJ3_besKJP_PF4Xh4PzCyiZmiQJqxhjDKKwznU79Ym0viTJp-RA9Oiwhpu7OqNw_Spps79eP4zymOZ4RgNNd3TEn6hF2r-Ukidv7OP0317B3Szqnhyi39JwJkqkzfCaEivDl6LbVgNIPsvASox8Quop-ZnnQ0d9tuLO2I_G9XChgi5nSb8od-2KNwKql42WDYQz7M0O8gyub1f8hYFFj_A9UePQhOvgFRustx_FJA%3D%3D)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic, and, conversely, how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
August 21, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

_**Kevin Faulconer Announces Endorsement from Latino American Political Association (LAPA) in Bid for San Diego County Supervisor**_
San Diego, CA – Kevin Faulconer, former mayor of San Diego and candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announced the endorsement of the Latino American Political Association (LAPA), one of the region’s most respected organizations advocating for the Latino community.
LAPA, known for its dedication to promoting civic engagement and representation within the Latino community, has chosen to endorse Faulconer due to his long-standing commitment to policies that support economic growth, public safety, and community development. The endorsement comes as Faulconer continues to gain momentum in his campaign to represent District 3 on the San Diego County Board of Supervisors.
_**“Kevin Faulconer is the best person for the job,” said Ed Cervantes, president of LAPA. “He has a proven track record of delivering results and working with our community. Unlike Terra Lawson-Remer, Kevin won’t let us down. We need a leader who understands our needs and will take decisive action to improve the lives of all residents in District 3. We believe Kevin is that leader. Terra Lawson-Remer has admitted that the homelessness problem has gotten worse under her tenure, yet she has done nothing to fix our region’s most pressing problem. Kevin Faulconer has addressed homelessness and achieved success helping people get off the street and into the safety of a shelter system he created. We trust he will follow through with these same real solutions, not just talk.”**_
During his tenure as mayor, Faulconer worked closely with Latino leaders and community organizations to champion initiatives that promoted job creation, small business growth, and improved public safety. His leadership in revitalizing neighborhoods and advocating for record infrastructure investments has been particularly impactful in Latino communities across the city.
_**“I am deeply honored to receive the endorsement of the Latino American Political Association,” said former Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for supervisor. “LAPA has been a powerful voice for the Latino community, and its support underscores my commitment to ensuring that every community in San Diego County has a seat at the table. I am committed to working with LAPA and other organizations to address the unique challenges facing our diverse communities, from creating good-paying jobs to ensuring safe neighborhoods and access to quality education.”**_
Faulconer’s campaign for San Diego County Supervisor is focused on delivering real solutions to the region’s most pressing issues, including homelessness, public safety, and economic opportunity. The endorsement from LAPA is a significant boost to his campaign and continues reflecting broad support from key community organizations. This latest endorsement comes on the heels of an endorsement from one of the region’s most prominent unions, the International Longshore and Warehouse Union (ILWU) of San Diego.
To learn more about Kevin Faulconer’s campaign for supervisor, go to [www.kevinfaulconer.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=fe9e6a0c06&e=784f78234b)

clean_body: Latino American Political Association Endorses Faulco | | | | | | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE August 21, 2024 CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com Kevin Faulconer Announces Endorsement from Latino American Political Association (LAPA) in Bid for San Diego County Supervisor San Diego, CA – Kevin Faulconer, former mayor of San Diego and candidate for San Diego County Supervisor, announced the endorsement of the Latino American Political Association (LAPA), one of the region’s most respected organizations advocating for the Latino community. LAPA, known for its dedication to promoting civic engagement and representation within the Latino community, has chosen to endorse Faulconer due to his long-standing commitment to policies that support economic growth, public safety, and community development. The endorsement comes as Faulconer continues to gain momentum in his campaign to represent District 3 on the San Diego County Board of Supervisors. “Kevin Faulconer is the best person for the job,” said Ed Cervantes, president of LAPA. “He has a proven track record of delivering results and working with our community. Unlike Terra Lawson-Remer, Kevin won’t let us down. We need a leader who understands our needs and will take decisive action to improve the lives of all residents in District 3. We believe Kevin is that leader. Terra Lawson-Remer has admitted that the homelessness problem has gotten worse under her tenure, yet she has done nothing to fix our region’s most pressing problem. Kevin Faulconer has addressed homelessness and achieved success helping people get off the street and into the safety of a shelter system he created. We trust he will follow through with these same real solutions, not just talk.” During his tenure as mayor, Faulconer worked closely with Latino leaders and community organizations to champion initiatives that promoted job creation, small business growth, and improved public safety. His leadership in revitalizing neighborhoods and advocating for record infrastructure investments has been particularly impactful in Latino communities across the city. “I am deeply honored to receive the endorsement of the Latino American Political Association,” said former Mayor Kevin Faulconer, candidate for supervisor. “LAPA has been a powerful voice for the Latino community, and its support underscores my commitment to ensuring that every community in San Diego County has a seat at the table. I am committed to working with LAPA and other organizations to address the unique challenges facing our diverse communities, from creating good-paying jobs to ensuring safe neighborhoods and access to quality education.” Faulconer’s campaign for San Diego County Supervisor is focused on delivering real solutions to the region’s most pressing issues, including homelessness, public safety, and economic opportunity. The endorsement from LAPA is a significant boost to his campaign and continues reflecting broad support from key community organizations. This latest endorsement comes on the heels of an endorsement from one of the region’s most prominent unions, the International Longshore and Warehouse Union (ILWU) of San Diego. And while I know folks like me probably send a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect.
We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first and was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet. Especially since I decided to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest. We won in 2020, and again in 2022, because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: working to elect more pro-democracy candidates in Arizona and beat Trump, Kari Lake, and the other MAGA Republicans up and down the ballot.
With some of the most competitive races in the country, Arizona is on the front lines of the fight to defend our democracy and continue to make progress on abortion access.

I wanted to share a little bit about my story, and why I’m in this fight, Peter. To put it frankly, I represent one of the most competitive House seats in the country, so if you’re already with me, **[please chip in $8 or any amount you can afford right now to help me defend this seat:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270009/493281448/-1837108903?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)** | | [DONATE NOW →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270010/493281449/-1837108903?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)
---
**Family means everything to me.** My parents came to Colorado from a small town in Mexico, looking for a better life. They knew that hard work and caring for others are the values that build strong communities and families. They raised me and my siblings with those values — on a construction worker’s salary, in the home they still live in.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270011/493281450/-1931070706?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)
**I went to medical school, becoming the first in my family to graduate from college.** But even before I finished my medical training, advocacy became an important part of my life. I helped organize my fellow medical residents for better working conditions, and became a union representative with SEIU.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270012/493281451/-1931070706?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)
I chose to be a pediatrician in Adams County to give back to my community – to the folks that raised me. **I quickly realized that doctors face major obstacles when trying to treat our patients.**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270013/493281452/-1931070706?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)**
**That’s why I ran for the state legislature.** In that time, I worked to pass legislation to force drug companies to lower the cost of prescriptions, expand funding for preschool, ensure all Coloradans have access to paid family leave and sick days, and protect renters from eviction during the pandemic.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270014/493281453/-1931070706?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)
And, Peter, that’s why I ran for Congress in 2022. **The pollsters said I didn’t have a shot of winning this race.** Thanks to this grassroots movement, we defied the odds and elected the first Latina to represent Colorado in Congress.
In Congress, I will continue my commitment to the families I see every day in Colorado. I will build on my work to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. [**I’m ready to continue advocating for Coloradans in Congress, but I can’t beat the far-right or get there alone. Your support was critical last time. So please, will you chip in to my congressional campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91270015/493281454/-1837108903?refcode=email_082224_maybeyouknow&amount=8&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzljNjVhZi0wOTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IWUj1LBNDe4_YZQGFkPbm4bUavw-vSqAE25LCDYAHOQ=)

Fellow Patriot, There’s no way around it: **Tim Kaine is absolutely TERRIFIED.**** ** He’s been sending out email after email twisting my words and ranting about the fact that someone dared to challenge him. Tim Kaine knows we have a real chance in Virginia, and right now he’s shaking in his boots. Virginia is sick of the Tim Kaine agenda:
* Sending money to countries who hate us and take advantage of us.
* Letting criminals run free with the soft-on-crime Biden Administration.
* Leaving our border WIDE OPEN.
* Raking in big dollars from special interests while everyday Virginians suffer under inflation.

body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Hey everyone,
It’s Joseph. I’m 9 years old, and I just got back from Day Two of the Democratic National Convention. It was pretty awesome. I’ve been learning a lot about the Midwest, how our government works, and why this election really matters.
Last night, I got to be on the convention floor with the Tennessee Delegation, and I even snapped a few pictures. One of my favorites has President Obama in it. My mom’s a big fan of Michelle Obama, and seeing her light up when Michelle spoke was a moment I won’t forget.
Here’s the thing: this election isn’t just another one. It’s about making sure people like my mom, Grandma, and little sister have the rights they deserve. I’m all in for Kamala Harris because having the first Black woman president would be a game-changer.
Michelle Obama told us to “Do something.” So, I’m on a mission. I’m raising $3,000 to help the Tennessee Voter Project turn Tennessee blue and get Kamala Harris elected. Every dollar we get helps us register new voters, educate people, and make sure they show up when it counts.
If you want to be part of something that matters, now’s the time. Clink the link to make a donation if you’re in, and let’s make this happen. I even included my exclusive photo of President Obama if you click the link.
Thanks for the support.
My name’s Joseph—and I approve this message.

body:
#
Peter,
Before Kamala takes the stage to accept the Democratic nomination tomorrow night, we wanted to share Eleni’s speech from the convention stage.
She talks about why Kamala Harris is going to make an incredible president, and how happy she is that the country is seeing the Kamala she’s known for years.
You can [**click here to watch on Youtube**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91271811/493287816/-803653937?v=_-dYn047V60&refcode=240821-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MjgwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZjkyZjhmOS0wZTYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dFcoFhruUT2yzj82jLbtu_sRv3DI9vcIj2OT9c7if4Q=&emci=2b0d55bf-fe5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=3f92f8f9-0e60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=18887817), or read her remarks below.
\- Team Eleni

* * *

_I, personally, can attest that Kamala is a leader who has our back._
_I’m California’s Lieutenant Governor Eleni Kounalakis._
_But I hold another title just as dear to me: Kamala Harris’s friend._
_I met her when we were both young women trying to navigate the halls of power._
_I worked in housing; she had just been elected District Attorney._
_We’d get frequent lunches. She was funny and fun._
_She was also a great mentor._
_Once I told her about a professional experience of being minimized because I was a woman._
_She put her fork down and said: “Eleni, never let anybody make you feel small.”_
_I saw her put that creed into action._
_When Wall Street foreclosed on millions of homes,_
_Washington wisdom was that $4 billion was the best you could get. Other Attorneys General agreed._
_But because Kamala Harris grew up in a middle-class home, she knew that wasn’t enough for working families._
_So she put her foot down and refused to settle for less._
_She won $20 billion from the big banks for California homeowners._
_That’s because she cares._
_She cares so much that she calls her friends on your birthday and sometimes she sings to you._
_She called me on mine, right when I had decided to run for Lieutenant Governor._
_She asked tough questions._
_I promised I’d follow her lead and invest in the future._
_Together, we shattered a glass ceiling and got to work!_
_I’m so glad the country is getting to see the Kamala I’ve known for over two decades._
_For Californians and Pennsylvanians...for Texans and for Wisconsinites...for states red and blue and everything in between...President Biden and Vice President Harris have been investing in our future and are on our side._
_And we’re not going back!_

* * *

Wednesday, August 21, 2024 | Peter -- As the Democrats gather for their convention in Chicago, it's important to remember the genesis of the Forward Party. Several years ago, unhappy with the state of the existing two parties, leaders from across the political spectrum joined together to give Americans a new and better option. Andrew Yang, a former Democrat, joined with Governor Christine Todd Whitman, a former Republican, to bring those of us together who are looking to put partisan fighting aside in service of values- and data-driven governance. As we watch the Convention from afar, as we did with the Republican Convention, it's important to remember just how separated from most of us these two events are. They're something the parties throw for themselves, not for the American people. An increasing number of Americans feel unrepresented by the two parties, which is why a majority of us now identify as Independent or unaffiliated. The Forward Party is here to build a better political party. One that truly listens to its membership and represents them, rather than takes them for granted. Building this is going to take more than a couple short months. It's going to be the result of years of labor and effort. It goes past one election, past the legacy parties of yesterday. In order to have a truly robust democracy, we need to remember what democracy is about. It's not about convincing voters to vote for you, it's about being the candidate (or party) that voters _want_ to vote for. There are some simple fixes to point us in that direction: robust and open primaries every election, ranked choice voting or another similar system that ensures majority support for the winner, and the end of partisan gerrymandering so politicians can't pick their voters but voters pick their politicians. We can build that world. It's within our grasp. Let's keep building it together.

Now, this was never going to be an easy race. But unlike my opponent, who can fund a campaign with his massive, unearned fortune, I'm used to doing things the hard way.
It wasn't easy for my family to leave behind everything and everyone we knew in Ecuador in search of a better life here in America. It wasn't easy getting up at the crack of dawn as a high schooler to go work in a donut shop and help my mom make ends meet. It wasn't easy paying my way through school to be a first-generation college graduate, becoming the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, or even winning this primary race.
I never let those challenges stop me from fulfilling my dream — _my American Dream_ — and finding ways to give back to the communities and the country that allowed me to get where I am today.
**And the road to defeating Rick Scott in November won't be easy either.** But based on everything we've accomplished so far (not to mention polls showing us statistically tied and his approval dropping with each passing day), I know we have what it takes to win.

Katie's term might be ending soon, **_but she's keeping up the fight for the American people._**
Earlier this month, she introduced the _Single Parent Penalty Elimination Act._ It’s a bill to eliminate a restriction in the law that makes too many single parents ineligible for the full child tax credit.
But to make sure this bill and the rest of Katie’s agenda is passed, we must elect candidates who aren’t afraid to stand up for families. **[Can you donate $5 today to help Truth to Power do just that?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240821?refcode=em20240821-39042&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39042_3422442_Ehj9zH&akid=39042%2E3422442%2EEhj9zH)**

**Katie’s fights will continue long after her time in Congress comes to end.** That’s why she’s continuing to introduce key legislation that will help American families. body:
This is how we’ll defeat the fossil fuel giants in November.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91273613/493293612/1328794144?refcode=ea.f5c4569d-1260-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.f5c4569d-1260-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY1YzQ1NjlkLTEyNjAtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=4ZjkbYPbMV98yd46i2i16m5Phu8wRujeEGiUsI2dEc0=&emci=4a78b185-fc5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=f5c4569d-1260-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=4823105)
---
I remember it as if it were yesterday. The cold steel of the handcuffs, the chanting of passionate voices, and the determination in my fellow protestors' eyes. Getting arrested for protesting climate inaction in 2019 was a life-changing experience. Thousands of people putting their bodies on the line to say _ENOUGH is ENOUGH. We need a fossil fuel-free future._ It was truly inspiring. _Millions_ of us need to channel that same _ENOUGH is ENOUGH_ energy right now as we face the most critical election for climate action in our lifetimes. **[WATCH ROBERT’S SPEECH](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91274359/493296098/-732903607?refcode2=b0de20c6-1860-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&refcode=em240821-1-solo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGRlMjBjNi0xODYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x0Zx6LW4Ku_LPwGsNnf14Ks6NwkILMPopmpnt7DOHl4=) **
In 2020, I was in my second term as Long Beach’s mayor when the COVID-19 pandemic began.
As mayor, I made it my priority to fight for more hospital beds, more tests, and to make masks more accessible. During that first treacherous year, we needed national leadership, but instead, we got Trump. He downplayed the virus and peddled conspiracy theories, and as a result, we lost hundreds of thousands of Americans — including my mom, a healthcare worker, and my stepfather.
So when Donald Trump and his MAGA extremist cronies downplay the horror of the pandemic, it makes me furious.
But Americans spoke up and elected Joe Biden and Kamala Harris to give us the leadership and change we needed. They got the virus under control. They got folks vaccinated. And they passed the historic American Rescue Plan.
I am a proud immigrant. I came to the United States as a young child, grew up poor, and like many immigrant families, struggled to get by. But my mom brought me here because she believed in the American Dream. And when I raised my right hand and became a citizen of our beautiful country, it was the proudest day of my life.
But if it were up to Trump, someone like me would never be serving our country.
On the other hand, it's people like Kamala Harris who inspire the American Dream my mother and I were able to achieve. And that’s the kind of leader we need as our next President—one who inspires hope, resilience, and progress. But she can’t do it alone.
**[So please, contribute to my re-election campaign today to help Democrats take back the House majority. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz need a Democratic House and Senate to help them defend our democracy from MAGA extremism.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91274360/493296101/-732903607?refcode2=b0de20c6-1860-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&refcode=em240821-1-solo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMGRlMjBjNi0xODYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x0Zx6LW4Ku_LPwGsNnf14Ks6NwkILMPopmpnt7DOHl4=)**
Never did it cross my mind that the young boy who immigrated here with little to nothing would not only be serving in Congress, but speaking at the Democratic National Convention.
I am eternally grateful for the opportunity this country has given me, and when we elect Kamala Harris as our first Black woman president, I know many other young people will see that they too, can achieve their American dream.
Thank you,
Robert Garcia

Friend,

On Monday night, I joined fellow Democrats at the Democratic National Convention in Chicago to celebrate as we nominate Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to be the next president and vice president of the United States.

If you have a moment, I hope you’ll listen to my full remarks. **[You can watch those here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91274353/493296065/-803653937?v=JznC5vZnGOQ&refcode=jtk5444-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjdmYzNiMC0xODYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=URqqWfmP_njJo4H1F86VdOPAfqZcNgwR4dCAzmG7efQ=&emci=871bdb71-fc5f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=0b7fc3b0-1860-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=1586379)**

What I tried to make clear was this: Elections are about the character of a country – and on November 5, we must choose between Kamala’s vision for the future and Donald Trump’s.

And on that front, the choice couldn’t be more clear. Kamala Harris and Tim Walz represent a new way forward. Forward on women’s reproductive rights, worker rights, and voting rights. And forward on affordable housing, access to health care, and so much more.
**[We’ve got to stand together, organize together, pray together, and work together to heal the land and elect Kamala Harris. If you’re with me, I hope you’ll pitch in a split donation between Kamala’s campaign and mine right away.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91274354/493296066/1047741283?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5444-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjdmYzNiMC0xODYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=URqqWfmP_njJo4H1F86VdOPAfqZcNgwR4dCAzmG7efQ=)**
Thanks for all you do to move our country forward.

– Rev. Warnock
